description: Creates a pay link (pay_url) for a business owner with NO Pagetool account: they pay by card (US cards only) a monthly subscription (default $25/month, or price_cents) that registers the domain, keeps it renewed and puts the site live on it automatically. If they cancel, or stay unpaid past the grace period, the site comes down. The link expires at expires_at. Signed-in accounts only. Free to create; it never charges you. A refused or unchecked domain ending carries `reason` and a plain `reason_text`: unsupported or price_unavailable mean we do not sell that ending right now; lookup_failed or cap_reached mean it was NOT checked, so search again, and never tell the customer we do not sell it.

business_name.description: The business name shown on the pay page.

contact_email.description: The business owner's email, for your records (Stripe also collects it at payment).

domain.description: The domain to register for them, bare, e.g. "joesbakery.com". Must be available; .com/.net/.org and other Cloudflare endings for now.

dry_run.description: true = quote only: runs every check and returns price, setup fee and registrar, but creates NO pay link.

price_cents.description: Custom price in cents per interval. Omit for the default ($25/month). Required when the domain costs more than $20/year.

site_key.description: The site the business is paying for (must be yours, and not yet live on a domain).

name: create_client_checkout
title: Create a client pay link
